labelingPolicy.simple: One independent user obligation or one informational event, with at most one directly attached time and no cross-fact dependency.
labelingPolicy.medium: Two related facts, a material or event relationship, a vague time, OCR/security noise, or one conditional branch that can still be reviewed as one compact unit.
labelingPolicy.complex: At least three independently editable actions/times, or a correction, conditional/dependent timing, multi-stage actor flow, or event-task relationship whose facts must be related across clauses.
